row.title: Repeated whole-window D1 scans keep the tick lean; cache closed hours and key reads on content
row.body: goal_samples was scanned for 14 days (18,590 rows) on every goals read and live_changes was re-read each tick because its refresh time moved; both are now served from keyed caches (closed-hour buckets, a content signature). Tests pass: 1091 seed worker tests; the cap is not raised.

title: Repeated whole-window D1 scans keep the tick lean; cache closed hours and key reads on content
